create_async_llm: create an AsyncLLM instance from VllmConfig for asynchronous LLM inference
create_async_llm_from_engine_args: create an AsyncLLM instance from AsyncEngineArgs configuration
run_async_llm_generate: run the AsyncLLM generate method to stream completion outputs for a prompt
run_async_llm_encode: run the AsyncLLM encode method to stream pooling outputs for a prompt
manage_async_llm_lora: manage LoRA adapters by adding, removing, listing, and pinning them on AsyncLLM
scale_async_llm_elastic_ep: scale the AsyncLLM data parallel engine size up or down dynamically
pause_resume_async_llm: pause and resume AsyncLLM generation for model weight updates
